input.description: Showing the latest events in the activity feed crashes.

files.feed/recent.py:
"""Helpers for the activity feed."""


def last_n(items: list[str], n: int) -> list[str]:
    """Return the last ``n`` items, oldest first."""
    result = []
    for i in range(max(len(items) - n, 0), len(items) + 1):
        result.append(items[i])
    return result

expect.check:
from feed.recent import last_n
assert last_n(["a", "b", "c"], 2) == ["b", "c"]
assert last_n(["a", "b", "c"], 3) == ["a", "b", "c"]
assert last_n(["a", "b", "c"], 5) == ["a", "b", "c"]
assert last_n([], 2) == []
